polar.description: source-centred polar frame relative to the downwind axis

coords.r: horizontal distance from the source centre (m)
coords.phi: angle from the downwind bearing b = wd + 180 (deg), clockwise positive viewed from above

polar.to_map: x = x_src + r sin(b + phi), y = y_src + r cos(b + phi); x east, y north

road.description: road-aligned Cartesian frame of a line source (segment centred on the source point)

coords.s: distance along the road axis (m); the axis bearing is a = wd + 180 + orientation_deg
coords.d: distance across the road axis (m), positive to the right of the axis direction

road.to_map: x = x_src + s sin a + d cos a, y = y_src + s cos a - d sin a

polar.order: C order (z, r, phi); phi fastest

road.order: C order (z, s, d); d fastest

polar.weights: linear in ln r, linear in phi (periodic), linear in z
polar.inside_r0: C = (r/r0) C(r0, phi, z) + (1 - r/r0) mean_phi C(r0, z)
polar.beyond_rmax: extrapolate ln C in ln r from the last two rings, never increasing

road.weights: linear in s, d and z

interpolation.values: interpolate ln C when all 8 corners > 0, otherwise C
interpolation.mirror: reflect the query point across the downwind axis through the source

road_baselines.description: Ground-level concentration of the road network (tiers 1 and 2) at the observed wind and the scenario hour's traffic, computed offline with aqsim.engine (Python reference) from the stored highway unit fields. Multiply by the traffic scale (0-2) and add to the total; hide when the wind is rotated.
road_baselines.units: µg/m³ at 100 % traffic (NOx counted as NOx; the app treats it as the NO2 upper limit)

grid.order: C order (j, i): row j from the south edge, x (i) fastest
grid.cell_centre: x = xmin + dx_m (i + 0.5), y = ymin + dx_m (j + 0.5)

vertical.order: C order (k, j, i): level k, row j from the south edge, x fastest
vertical.cell_centre: x = xmin + dx_m (i + 0.5), y = ymin + dx_m (j + 0.5)
vertical.note: coarse companion for the cross-section; 200 m cells smooth the near-road structure, so values within about 200 m of a road are approximate
